title: Shell Island Shuttle
specs: Shell Island is a pristine 7-mile long undeveloped barrier island in St. Andrews State Park
Snorkeling habitats include sand bottom, shallow grass flats, and rocky jetties with tropical fish, crabs, rays, sea turtles, and dolphins
Pontoon boats are safe, stable, spacious, and easy to operate for family or group adventures
Can I swim with the dolphins?
Swim with our local, friendly dolphins that regularly frolic along the shores of Shell Island.
What's the minimum age for renting a pontoon boat?
You must be at least 21 with a Florida boaters license to rent any watercraft in Florida.
Do I need a boating license?
To operate the boat without a boating license, you must be born before Jan.
If you need a boating license, you will have to follow the link in the confirmation email to take the test.
